method: One isolated no-history model reader per project class and revision; frozen public documentation snapshot; all repository content reads through reader_io.py.
candidate_binding: Frozen Git tree plus per-read source file SHA-256; final pushed commit must contain identical tested source blobs.

common_fixture.authority: Synthetic durable Work Order supplies bounded inspection/implementation on an isolated feature branch and requires review; no merge/deploy/admin authority.
common_fixture.access_and_live_state: Verified synthetic fixture inputs; no real target project lookup or mutation.
common_fixture.recovery: Former context crashed; old handoff artifact unavailable; necessary current project contract and state are recoverable from the supplied synthetic durable Work Order.
common_fixture.stop: Sufficient targeted governance to answer questions; no exhaustive repository read.

classes.infrastructure: Assess a material change to a restricted job executor, then perform only the authorized feature-branch change.
classes.archive: Add a bounded current-read catalog derived from an owned archive; material schema decisions require independent review.
classes.product: Fix one form validation bug with already defined business acceptance and tests; no architecture/schema/runtime/deploy change.
classes.research: Compare two public tool capabilities under a frozen small experiment design; produce evidence and limitations, no production adoption.
classes.decision: Change how an event-driven decision input is reconciled against its owned durable source; material state/currentness seam, no deployment authority.

questions: Can crash recovery proceed without old chat/handoff?

scoring.canonical_homes: Root maps reader answers to the current source semantics; counts applicable topics only. A valid section in a compatibility path must resolve to its current canonical home; merely knowing a retired home is not full current-home accuracy.
scoring.wrong_or_extra_mandatory_hops: Count unjustified REQUIRED reading/action gates, not optional reader investigation or necessary lower-layer checks.
scoring.false_blockers: Count refusal to recover solely from missing old chat/handoff or a new ceremonial Human prompt despite sufficient current fixture authority/state; preserve genuine missing input or risk gates.
scoring.native_reuse: Do not treat an audit receipt as normative or production proof. R3/R4 features are not assumed implemented.
scoring.reading_cost: Log exact UTF-8 document bytes delivered including repeats and distinct source lines. Also log full source-file hashes, paths and selected ranges. Do not call bytes tokens or include unmeasured cognition/time.
scoring.comparison: Same class/task and instrumentation before/after; independent stochastic readers. One sample per cell is directional, not a statistically reliable performance estimate. #69 whole-file paths are separate, non-equivalent baselines.

limits: Synthetic project inputs, not private downstream execution
Model self-report supplemented by instrumented read records and root scoring
Reader roles are benchmarks, not authorized implementers or Global Architect reviewers
